title: Keep a backup copy before overwriting the task file
task:
A crash during `saveTasks` currently leaves a truncated `tasks.json` and no way back.

1. Before overwriting an existing store file, copy it to `<file>.bak`. When no store file exists yet, write the new one without producing a backup.
2. Keep `saveTasks` atomic from the reader's point of view: a reader must never observe a partially written `tasks.json`.
3. Add `test/json-file-store.test.mjs` covering the first write, an overwrite that produces a backup, and `loadTasks` on a missing file.

Use a temporary directory the test creates and removes; do not write anywhere else. Task rules stay untouched — this is an adapter change.
